card.name: Words right after a negation or warning
card.fires_on: The word just after a negation or prohibition such as "not", "Do not use", or "alone will not". It also fires on small words in warning headings and disclaimers.

modes.label: After a prohibition
modes.description: Small word following "Do not use" or "should not be used" in disclaimers.
modes.example: Do not use<< for>> reproduction, copying, pasting, or

modes.label: After "not" in a limiting statement
modes.description: A word after "not" or "will not" saying something is insufficient or not a substitute.
modes.example: Levalbuterol inhalation solution is not<< a>> substitute for corticosteroids.

modes.label: Warning headings
modes.description: Commas or "and" inside capitalized warning titles or cross-references.
modes.example: WARNING: EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY, MALIGNANCIES<<,>> AND SERIOUS INFECTIONS Use during

card.writes: It pushes toward emphatic negating words such as "this is not", "not suitable", "NOT" and "THIS", mostly in Chinese.
card.plain: It lights up on the word right after a "not" or "do not" in a warning or disclaimer.
